title: 51:7 heart I have written my law. We are truly of God, not only when our acts reflect obedience to God's law but when our hearts—meaning our feelings, desires, attitudes, and intentions—are all turned to do his will. When we submit ourselves to God, he writes his law in our hearts even as he wrote the law on tablets of stone in Moses' day (Ps. 37:31; 40:8; 119:34).
author: Tina M. Peterson
